# LoopCarry product notes

LoopCarry sells reusable shopping bags online in India. The featured product is a 15-litre recycled cotton tote with reinforced handles. The product name is Recycled Cotton Tote. It costs INR 499 and is currently in stock. The objective of this product page is purchases. There is no evidence that the bag is organic, certified carbon-neutral, waterproof, or the best-selling bag in India.
